meta.field_sourcing_rule: Every non-null clinical field value was entered only from a source consulted in the building session and is cited per field in the record's 'sources' map. Fields not available from a consulted source are null and carry an explicit entry in the record's 'verify' list. No field was filled from unaided recall.
meta.ta_name_status: ta_name is null on every record in this tranche and verify-flagged: Terminologia Anatomica names were not present in the consulted sources and are not carried by the BodyParts3D/FMA tables used for the inventory.
meta.sourcing_tiers: A = every clinical field sourced; B = sourced except arterial supply and/or innervation root values; C = at least one core field (origin, insertion, actions, innervation) verify-flagged.
meta.geometry_linkage: geometry.inventory_record_ids reference records in data/muscular/muscle-inventory.json; mesh detail lives in data/muscular/muscle-geometry.json.
